annotations.title: Check: price, networks and fee wallets

description: The paid Check of any wallet (owner, 18/11/2026: one mark per paid tool, the person chooses which; the free OFAC and issuer freeze screening always runs). toolOffer [{ tool, per ("wallet" or "network"), price, maximum, kycRequired? }]: each paid tool on sale, at its own price (dollars as text): scorechain per wallet (one reading answers every network of the family: an EVM wallet and a Solana one are two), merkle-science and crystal per network, each never above its maximum; crystal only for a payer with an approved KYC. A tool switched off or without a price is not listed. The price of a Check is the SUM over the tools chosen of price x units (wallets or networks), each capped at its maximum: the same reckoning check_charge charges. tools: the names on sale; defaultTools: what check_charge buys without tools (the pair, for older clients); freeScreening: ["ofac", "issuer-freeze"]. price { perNetwork, maximum, amount, currency }: Merkle Science alone, for older clients. checkNetworks [{ chainId, family }] (the seven to choose: 1, 10, 56, 137, 8453, 42161, solana-mainnet), networks [{ chainId, family, token (the USDC that pays), feeWallet }] (where it is paid: the nine EVM networks and solana-mainnet), creditLimit and chargeValidSeconds (1800). Public, no proof needed.
name: check_info
